circuit.name: merkle16
circuit.statement: public root, nullifierHash, context; private nullifier, trapdoor, 16 siblings and index bits; nullifierHash == MiMC(nullifier), leaf == MiMC(nullifier, trapdoor), the path from leaf hashes to root (MiMC(left, right) per level); context is bound only as a public input
